hero_subtitle: Explore how Pendle Borough Council spends public money. All data comes from publicly available council documents.
publisher_bio: This website was created by Tom Pickup, Reform UK county councillor for Padiham and Burnley West and Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care at Lancashire County Council. He is also parish councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw. Tom builds transparency tools that make public spending data easier to check.
publisher_titles: County Councillor for Padiham and Burnley West
Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care, Lancashire County Council
Parish Councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw
publisher_quote: It's your money. The more people understand where it goes, the better.

doge_context.political_control: No overall control. Lib Dem/Independent Group coalition (19 of 33 filled seats, 3 vacancies). Conservative largest single party (11 seats).
doge_context.transaction_profile: Highest transaction volume despite lowest total spend — many small payments.

doge_findings.ch_red_flags: £815.2K to 23 suppliers with Companies House compliance issues
doge_findings.ch_breach_spend: £37.8K to 4 suppliers during active Companies House breaches — lowest of 3 councils
doge_findings.transaction_volume: 49,741 transactions — highest of 3 councils despite lowest total spend, driven by vehicle hire and fuel micro-payments
doge_findings.year_end_spike: Financial Services spent 2.7x monthly average in March — below 3x threshold
doge_findings.benfords_law: 3.3% max digit deviation — within normal range

spend_triangulation.note: Transparency gross = £125.0M across every class in the published corpus. Procurement-paid (discretionary third-party payments) = £124.1M. Non-procurement rows: Care-Act redacted direct payments to individuals (£894.5K) — all excluded from third-party-supplier forensic analyses. Net revenue budget figures (where published) are smaller again because they net capital, grants received, and reserves movements — transparency totals include all of these.
